item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day has a lot of moments built in for calm and reflection, and water is the simplest way to support all of it. Even mild dehydration dulls focus and mood. Don't wait for thirst. Drink a full glass when you wake, then keep a bottle within reach and finish it before midday. Small, steady sips beat catching up later. Right now, pour a glass of water and drink it.
